sections.title: Letters au sound
paragraphs: The letters au make the main sound /ɔː/, as in (author) /ɔː.θər/, a writer. This letter pair has three different sounds.

sections.title: How to say au
paragraphs: For the first sound, pull your tongue back into the mid mouth and round your lips. For the second sound, drop your jaw open wide and keep your tongue low and back. For the third sound, drop your jaw open slightly and round your lips lightly. Touch your throat to feel your voice shake on all three sounds.

sections.title: Spelling of au
paragraphs: The letters au usually make the sound /ɔː/ before consonants, as in (pause) /pɔːz/. In a few words before certain consonants, they make the sound /ɑː/, as in (aunt) /ɑːnt/. In words like (sausage) /sɒ.sɪdʒ/, they make the sound /ɒ/.

sections.title: Mistakes with au
paragraphs: Do not read these letters as two separate vowels. Do not glide between sounds as in out. Keep your mouth steady on one vowel.
